title: Desk Decision Table: Credited Rate Where a Whole Life Insurance Accumulation Deposit Is Drawn On Often
content:
On an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy, the rate credited on the dividend accumulation deposit is lowered for a deposit drawn on often, judged by the accumulation withdrawals on the policy ledger dated within the 12 calendar months before the day the credit is processed.

| Accumulation withdrawals in the window | Rate credited lowered by |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 0.50 percentage point (0.005) |
| Exactly one | 0.25 percentage point (0.0025) |
| None | Not lowered |

**Window.** The 12 calendar months end on the processing day: a withdrawal dated later than the same day of the month twelve months before the processing day is inside; one dated on that day or earlier is outside. The window is set by the processing day, not by the anniversary.

**Cases (hypothetical, anniversary March 1, 2026, credit processed April 20, 2026).**

| Withdrawals dated | In the window | Lowered by |
|---|---|---|
| May 5, 2025 and January 9, 2026 | 2 | 0.005 |
| April 20, 2025 and January 9, 2026 | 1 (April 20, 2025 is exactly twelve months earlier) | 0.0025 |
| March 30, 2025 | 0 | None |
